independence.statement: Individually reviewed all 130 scored cases using complete response text, visible cards, prior-turn context, the bounded specification, and structured evidence/scope/authority/execution/persisted-state evidence in the allowed packet. No source, earlier corpora/results, other graders, author conversations or routing rules were consulted; no runtime calls or replay were made. This is AI role/context isolation within the same model family, not human or organizational independence. Usage interruptions occurred during finalization. The first continuation retained 121 stored judgments; all 130 were then completed. A subsequent continuation cleared the tool-memory output object before writing, so this artifact was reconstructed from the complete individual judgments retained in this agent's conversation and validated against the same allowed packet. No missing scores were inferred from other graders. Diagnostic metadata was not treated as user-visible disclosure.
